_readme: Prompt registry. Edit the .txt files to change a prompt; changes apply on the next AI call (no restart). To change behaviour safely, add a NEW version instead of editing an old one, then set 'active'. Placeholders in {braces} are filled by code; literal braces in judge.user.txt are doubled {{ }}.

v2.note: Search plan with a dedicated travel search; headcount bands are not exact numbers; fewer false conflicts.

v3.note: Labels every travel finding business_travel / local_field_travel / unclear.

v4.note: Standard research narrowed to the 5 routing-relevant basics (industry, locations, employees, funding, hiring). Travel, expansion and support complexity move to Deep Research. Company-stated rounded headcounts count as figures.

deep.note: Deep Research: comprehensive second pass over all 8 fields, reusing what is already known. Compares signup inputs with public research (source dates, estimates, different entities) and separates explicit business-travel requirements from indirect growth signals.

repair.note: Sent once when the AI's JSON fails validation.

judge.note: AI judge: one-sentence why, support level, main doubt. v2 requires 'rests on X, evidence shows Y, so Tier Z'. v3 explains the case FOR the proposal from its basis (Day 30 activity vs signup evidence) and caps Day 30 support at partial.
